about.title: About us
about.intro: Bionexo is the circular-economy marketplace of Tu Basura Innova, a Colombian ecosystem that brings together citizens, recyclers, entrepreneurs, and businesses around a shared purpose: giving waste a new life and transforming the way we consume.
about.originBody: We are a joint initiative born from the work of a team from eastern Colombia (Santander) and the nation's capital (Bogotá D.C.), with the goal of growing to reach the entire country and region.
about.productsTitle: What will you find at Bionexo?
about.productsBody: Products and materials born from reuse and recycling: from recovered materials and furniture made with reclaimed plastic and wood, to sustainable fashion, organic fertilizers, eco-friendly cleaning products, handicrafts, and much more. Every purchase supports the entrepreneurs building a cleaner, fairer economy.
about.whyStat1Label: tons of solid waste per year in Colombia
about.whyStat2Label: of the total is recycled or reused
about.whyBody: In that vast wasted potential we see an opportunity: to turn waste into products, and products into progress.
about.missionBody: To give visibility to and strengthen Colombia's circular-economy ventures, connecting them with people and companies who want to consume responsibly. We believe that what is discarded today can become an opportunity tomorrow.
about.goalBody: To reach the entire country and region, connecting more and more entrepreneurs and buyers committed to sustainability.
about.odsTitle: We contribute to the Sustainable Development Goals
about.umbrellaTitle: Tu Basura Innova, our parent brand
about.umbrellaBody: Tu Basura Innova is a technological and social platform for recycling, circular economy, and environmental management, aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals. Bionexo is its commercial heart: where sustainability becomes a product, and recycling becomes progress.
about.cta: When you buy at Bionexo, you don't just get a product — you close the loop.
